Container.Name: mibee-nvr

Branch.description: Pinned release tag — use for reproducible rollbacks

Container.Overview: Lightweight Network Video Recorder for the edge. ONVIF/RTSP/MJPEG camera support, pure-Go recording & merge (no FFmpeg required), browser-side AI detection (ONNX Runtime Web), and FTP/WebDAV/WebRTC streaming. Built as a single static binary, multi-arch Docker image. On first launch open the Web UI and complete the setup wizard. Recordings/DB/config persist under /data.

Config.Name: Data (recordings / DB / config)
Config.Description: Persist recordings, SQLite DB, config and AI models. Point this at a share on your storage pool (ideally an external/parity-protected array).

Config.Name: NVR_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Storage path inside the container. Must match the volume target (/data).

Config.Name: NVR_UID
Config.Description: UID to run as. Set to the owner of the data share (default 99 = nobody on unRAID).

Config.Name: NVR_GID
Config.Description: GID to run as (default 100 = users on unRAID).

Config.Name: Web / API (host)
Config.Description: Host-network: binds directly to host :9090. To change, edit server.listen in mibee-nvr.yaml, NOT this field.

Config.Name: FTP (host)
Config.Description: Host-network: FTP control port on host. Configure via ftp.* in mibee-nvr.yaml.
